MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL by the supplied regime signal, with normal volatility at 28.7% and weak breadth: 0/8 sectors positive. Participation is exceptionally narrow; the regime label does not capture the weak breadth cleanly under the stated rules.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Holding & Investment leads on relative resilience (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -9.45%), followed by Retail & Food (-3.24% | -9.66%) and Transportation (-3.35% | -9.18%); all are BELOW TREND. HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%) are both RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom is weakest (1W: -13.92% | 1M: -23.26%), followed by Energy & Chemicals (-10.21% | -19.76%) and Heavy Industry (-8.49% | -19.05%); all are BELOW TREND. Selling is broad, with every sector down on both timeframes.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) RECOVERY; SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%) RECOVERY; SOKM (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.17%) BELOW TREND. ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%) and TAVHL (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -2.57%) are BELOW TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%), GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%), VESTL (1W: -19.50% | 1M: -38.34%), TRMET (1W: -14.08% | 1M: -25.34%) and HEKTS (1W: -13.79% | 1M: -18.98%) are all BELOW TREND. The steep weekly losses add to already severe one-month declines.

6. Momentum Stocks?
HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%) show the strongest weekly momentum, both RECOVERY. No other listed stock posted a positive 1W return.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance is BELOW TREND, with sector returns of 1W: -4.20% and 1M: -7.65%. HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) is a RECOVERY outlier; AKBNK (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -10.33%) and ISCTR (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -7.80%) remain BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is BELOW TREND (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -19.05%), with broad weakness across the group. EREGL (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.71%), FROTO (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -15.96%) and ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%) are BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is the second-weakest sector, BELOW TREND at 1W: -10.21% and 1M: -19.76%. TUPRS (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -10.60%), SASA (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -24.17%) and SISE (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -13.44%) are all BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay defensive and preserve liquidity; 0/8 positive sectors and universal sector declines argue against broad risk-taking. Keep exposure selective and require improving breadth before adding materially.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Track whether recovery attempts hold in HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%), both RECOVERY. Monitor relative resilience in SOKM (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.17%) and ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%), both BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Holding & Investment (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -9.45%), Retail & Food (-3.24% | -9.66%) and Transportation (-3.35% | -9.18%) for signs of stabilization; all remain BELOW TREND. A sustained improvement in breadth would be needed to confirm a turn.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided, so specific index levels cannot be assessed. Key triggers are breadth recovering from 0/8 and volatility moving out of the normal 25–40% band; no company or macro catalysts were supplied.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The supplied regime is NEUTRAL, but normal volatility at 28.7% contrasts with exceptionally weak breadth at 0/8, and every sector is down on both weekly and monthly measures. HALKB and SAHOL show short-term recovery signals, while deep losses in technology, energy and heavy industry keep downside risk elevated; favor liquidity and wait for broader confirmation.
